title: Let's Go Rolling!
statementMd:
On a number axis directed from the left rightwards, $*n*$ marbles with coordinates $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ are situated. Let's assume that the sizes of the marbles are infinitely small, that is in this task each of them is assumed to be a material point. You can stick pins in some of them and the cost of sticking in the marble number $*i*$ is equal to $*c*_{*i*}$, number $*c*_{*i*}$ may be negative. After you choose and stick the pins you need, the marbles will start to roll left according to the rule: if a marble has a pin stuck in it, then the marble doesn't move, otherwise the marble rolls all the way up to the next marble which has a pin stuck in it and stops moving there. If there is no pinned marble on the left to the given unpinned one, it is concluded that the marble rolls to the left to infinity and you will pay an infinitely large fine for it. If no marble rolled infinitely to the left, then the fine will consist of two summands:

- the sum of the costs of stuck pins;
- the sum of the lengths of the paths of each of the marbles, that is the sum of absolute values of differences between their initial and final positions.

Your task is to choose and pin some marbles in the way that will make the fine for you to pay as little as possible.

## Input

The first input line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3000$) which is the number of marbles. The next $*n*$ lines contain the descriptions of the marbles in pairs of integers $*x*_{*i*}$, $*c*_{*i*}$ ($- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$). The numbers are space-separated. Each description is given on a separate line. No two marbles have identical initial positions.

## Output

Output the single number — the least fine you will have to pay.
statementZhMd:
在一条从左向右延伸的数轴上，放置着 $*n*$ 个坐标分别为 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ 的弹珠。假设弹珠的大小无限小，也就是说，在本题中每个弹珠都被视为一个质点。你可以在其中一些弹珠上插入图钉，在编号为 $*i*$ 的弹珠上插入图钉的代价为 $*c*_{*i*}$，其中 $*c*_{*i*}$ 可能为负数。

在你选择并插入所需的图钉后，弹珠将按照以下规则开始向左滚动：如果一个弹珠上插有图钉，那么该弹珠不会移动；否则，该弹珠会一直向左滚动，直到到达左侧最近的一个插有图钉的弹珠，并在那里停止。如果某个未插图钉的弹珠左侧不存在任何插有图钉的弹珠，则认为该弹珠会一直向左滚动至无穷远，你将因此支付无限大的罚款。

如果没有弹珠向左滚动至无穷远，那么罚款由以下两部分组成：

- 插入图钉的总代价；
- 每个弹珠滚动路径长度之和，即其初始位置与最终位置之差的绝对值之和。

你的任务是选择一些弹珠并在其上插入图钉，使你需要支付的罚款尽可能小。

## 输入格式

第一行输入一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 3000$），表示弹珠的数量。接下来的 $*n*$ 行每行包含一对整数 $*x*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$（$- 10^{9} ≤ *x*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$），表示第 $*i*$ 个弹珠的描述。两个数之间用空格分隔。每个描述单独占一行。任意两个弹珠的初始位置都不相同。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即你需要支付的最小罚款。
